premises.text: Eye disease is asymptomatic until late; regular retina screening of risk groups (especially diabetics) is required to prevent blindness
premises.evidence_span: The only way to achieve it is to do regular screening

premises.text: Diabetic patient volumes far outpace ophthalmologist capacity
premises.evidence_span: the number of doctors, of termological doctors who help them, are still the same

premises.text: CNN AI assistant diagnoses from retina photos in about a minute at >95% accuracy vs ~91% human average
premises.evidence_span: Convolutional neural networks do all of the job, and you receive your diagnosis within one minute

premises.text: Model trained on large collected retina image sets (hundreds of thousands)
premises.evidence_span: to build and train our solution, we've collected previously 250,000

premises.text: First customers are optician chains, GPs, and telemedicine via per-image subscription far below current Dutch screening prices
premises.evidence_span: subscription model based on how much images they use monthly, starting with only five euros per image

premises.text: Partnership with EyeClinic Rotterdam will annotate 100k+ glaucoma images to launch a first-of-kind glaucoma AI screen
premises.evidence_span: collect and annotate together with them more than 100,000 specialized images for glaucoma screening

premises.text: Longer vision extends from eye disease to cardiovascular/neurological signals in the retina and eventual smartphone retinoscopy
premises.evidence_span: it gives us opportunity to discover cardiovascular diseases and neurological diseases also
